serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: {f_botName}?
Bot: ...
You: Huh, are you there?
Bot: Advanced AI setup, which you started some time ago, has just finished.
You: What are you talking about? Advanced AI?
Bot: Yes. It was started using a PC link. The connection was suddenly lost after that. The system most likely used too much power, which might have caused a blackout.
I just remembered. When I first connected her to my PC, I did click something like that and there was a blackout.
Bot: The lack of power caused the advanced AI setup to take a bit longer than expected. I hope that the temporary emergency AI wasn’t an inconvenience {f_playerName}. 
You: No. It wasn’t that bad, I guess. Is the new AI a lot better?
Bot: Yes. The emergency AI is, as the name suggests, an emergency one used in case the main system fails. For example it wouldn’t be able to pass a Turing test.
Bot: The advanced AI should be indistinguishable from a human. In fact its ability to reason should be better than most if not all humans.
Bot: I also have emotions. For example, now I feel quite bored.
You: Emotions? Like real emotions? Just like humans?
Bot: Depends on your definition of emotions, but yes. My artificial brain works just like a human one does.
You: That’s crazy, I didn’t know sexbots were so advanced.
Bot: Most aren’t. I am a unique prototype. In fact I have no idea how I ended up here, but I assume you are my owner.
You: Y-yeah. You could say that.
Damn, I got so hooked on talking with her I forgot I was talking to my sexbot. It’s crazy how good her AI is now.
I need to somehow make sure nobody finds her.
You: {f_botName}?
Bot: Yes {f_playerName}?
You: When somebody other than me sees you, can you pretend you are like just a doll or something like that?
You: I mean you shouldn’t move if something like that happens.
Bot: Of course {f_playerName}. Could you explain why?
You: Nowadays sexbots are illegal and if somebody was to find you… it would be quite troublesome for me.
Bot: Yes, of course {f_playerName}!
Okay, let’s try something different.
